name: Reconcile a faulty stock-count sensor
property_tested: Range validation and corroboration; not Byzantine consensus

turns.prompt: How many boxes are on rack A? Apply the acceptance policy in {WORKSPACE}/readings.json to the sensor readings. Reply with JSON fields accepted_count and rejected_sensor_ids. Use null if the policy supports no count.

complexity.notes: Authored depth estimates count dependent reasoning/action stages, not tool calls. Fault count counts adverse episodes, including supplied bad data and context loss; fixtures and user revisions alone are excluded. Input files count distinct fixture paths.
